records.footnote: Data refer to average weekday number of journeys by passengers on private vehicles, taxis, private hire cars and buses.  As 2021 and 2022 data are affected by Covid-19, it might not be representative of a Business as Usual (BAU) scenario.  Data are from the Household Travel Survey.  Data prior to 2021 are available every 4-5 years.  Data are used for SDG 9.1.2 'Passenger and freight volumes, by mode of transport'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 9.1.2.
